Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Additional Government Advocate for the respondents.
2.

The petitioners have filed this present petition seeking for a writ of mandamus directing the respondents/authority to initiate acquisition proceedings and pay the compensation in respect of their land bearing Sy.No.1415/7 to the extent of 33 guntas situated at Raichur village, Raichur Taluka.

sentences.text: 2 3. The petitioners contended that they are the owners and in possession of the agricultural land bearing Sy.No.1415 measuring 17 acres 25 guntas situated at Ward No.2 Raichur City, Raichur District.

There is a bullock cart way in the said land for movement of other land owners and farmers,
but according to the petitioners, from Raichur to Matamari, a road has been constructed without acquiring by following due process of law by the respondents.
The road in petitioners' land bearing Sy.No.1415/7 constructed from Raichur to Matamari is illegal and without any proper notice or acquisition proceedings.
When the petitioners applied for the record of rights of Sy.No.1415/7 situated at Ward No.2 Raichur City, Raichur District, they got information about the entries regarding Raichur to Matamari road.

Therefore, it is the contention of the petitioners that the respondents/authority have not acted in accordance with law, neither they have initiated any proceedings nor given any notice to the petitioners for formation of the road.
Learned Additional Government Advocate contends that there is no clarity in the writ petition filed by the petitioners.
It is not clearly stated as to whether the formation of the road is already done in the property in question.
Therefore, the claim made by the petitioner is not acceptable.

5. Be that as it may, it is the categoric submission of the learned counsel for the petitioners that their property to an extent of 33 guntas has been taken away for formation of the road without initiating acquisition proceedings and no payment of compensation is made.

It is trite law that under Article 300A of the Constitution of India, the rights of the parties towards their properties is protected and any property of the citizen is taken away, the same shall be in accordance with law by proper procedure known to law.

Therefore, this petition would be disposed of with the following directions:
(i) The respondents/authority shall consider the representation of the petitioners made at NC: 2023:KHC-K:8571 Annexure - C dated 02.05.2023 with regard to acquisition of the property belonging to the petitioners in Sy.No.1415/7, if any, made by the respondents/authority for formation of the road without initiating any acquisition proceedings and without payment of any compensation.

(ii) If no such property of the petitioners is acquired, respondents/authority shall give an endorsement by notifying the petitioners and giving the proper hearing and notice to the concerned parties.
Accordingly, this petition is disposed of.
